source.title: The Corroded Core
source.description:
This C.O.R.E. unit definitely fits the description that Ziri gave you, but it's badly damaged and covered in gunk. You can barely make out a faded sticker with what appears to be contact information for some sort of warranty. Only a few letters are visible.

"Limi... arranty... claims contac.... Wi..... nde...ar"
source.objective: Find someone who can repair the Corroded G-7 C.O.R.E Processor.
source.progress: When someone builds a tower and workshop on top of a giant spire in the middle of nowhere, it's almost like they don't want unexpected visitors. Who'd have thought?
source.completion:
<Wirdal's magnifying goggles make a low mechanical buzzing noise as they focus on the Corroded G-7 C.O.R.E. Processor in your hand> Indeed, that's one of mine.

I strongly suggest that you throw that thing into the ocean and never think of it again.
